subject: Crossed fork with spoon
parts: a fork at upper left made from a rounded U-shaped outer pair of tines and a central tine that joins the U base and continues as one solid single-line diagonal handle to lower right, a hollow oval spoon bowl at upper right joined to one solid single-line diagonal handle toward lower left, the two single-line handles crossing as an X with a one-stroke-width white break in the spoon handle on each side of the crossing; all three fork tines connect at their base and neither handle has an outlined interior
